newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Petre Roman, speaker of the upper house, the Senate, confirmed that the boards of state-run commercial banks will also include persons with official political affiliation.

* The Romanian government observes the minorities' rights, said Max Van der Stoel, High Commissioner of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe, after meeting Ion Diaconescu, chairman of the lower Chamber of Deputies.
* Integration Minister Alexandru Herlea will lobby for Romania's quick admission to NATO during a six-day visit to Washington.
* More than 75 percent of Romanians favour the country's quick admmission to NATO, according to a survey released on Thursday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
